_about: The quest camps upstream archived as post-legacy spawns that the period's walkthroughs describe, copied back once per world by deploy/bin/quest_camps.py (owner's choice 2026-10-12; research dillus-guards-2026-10-12 on the owner's machine). Each camp: key (its marker quest-camp:<key> in fork_world_fixes), name (for the start log), names (the rows' names, compared without case), ids (Mob_IDs in offline_classic165_removed_mobs), why (the period source). The other kinds are in deploy/bin/quest_camps.py's docstring: clone, archive and path (2026-10-22: a quest monster's walk; Mulgrut Maggot's, with his escort as clones).

camps.name: Delfina's camp
camps.why: Level 43 "Lord of Deceit": Rhodri sends the player to "infiltrate a camp of Tylwyth Teg elves. There is one among them named Delfina" (Allakhazam cquest 363, 2002-09-18); "there is a small campfire, with some Teg Rangers...she is by the fire, linked to 2 rangers" (Allakhazam Pennine bestiary forum, posted 2002-08-08). Upstream archived the 22 rangers within 1250 units of her as post-legacy and left her alone. mob_fixes.json moves the two nearest beside her.

camps.name: the isolationist camp
camps.why: Level 45 "Lord of Deceit": "The courier is next to the tent and he is linked to the two by the fire. When I did this it was a female wizard and a male armsman." (WarCry 645, capture 2002-06-03); the camp "at about loc [38k, 53k]" (2004-04-09) and "I found the Isolationist tent at roughly 35K, 56K" (Allakhazam q376, 2004-03-30), south-east of Caer Berkstead. These are the 39 archived rows of that camp (Pennine loc 35313-39883, 53015-58065). mob_fixes.json moves the courier beside the armsman by the tent.

camps.name: the Ellyll Seer's village
camps.why: Level 48 "Lord of Deceit": the seer in his hut in an Ellyll village of the Pennine Mountains, "Seers BAF, be prepared" (2002); Prima's Pennine key gives the Ellyll villages "Quantity 20-30". Upstream archived the 30 guards and villagers within 1500 units of the seer, leaving one villager and five guards.

camps.name: Lieutenant Grimarth
camps.why: Level 20/25: the renegades' officer at Sir Dillus's tower in Llyn Barfog, "Lieutenant Grimarth ... Minimum Level : 21 Maximum Level : 21" (Allakhazam cmob 6396, entry 2003-04-02); "Lt. grimarth and two guards will make the rounds coming down into the valley" (2003-01-02). He stands where upstream's row had him: no period route for his patrol survives.

camps.name: Lieutenant Cian
camps.why: #121: capnbry's radar logged Captain Rhodri, Lieutenant Brude and "Lieutenant Cian" (level 49) together on Snowdonia Fortress's north wall, Z 9200 (2002-2004), and Cian helps Rhodri kill the level-30 assassin (2002-07-11); our world has no Cian. He is made like Lt. Brude (model, gear, realm, level) beside him; NPCTemplateID -1, since Brude's template would name him Brude. The owner checked the spot in game (2026-10-13).

camps.name: the generated Bline
camps.why: #126: the level-7 supply run's first step went to the Humberton merchant Bline Tengit ("Bline is his FIRST name!! he stands outside the door", 2002-09-22); upstream's generator made a level-5 peace-flagged "Bline" at the bindstone, 959 units east. The quest goes to Bline Tengit now (mob_fixes.json), and this copy is archived.

camps.name: the standing Martley
camps.why: #124: Martley appears at the single-tent camp of drakoran neophytes ("he spawns in the single tent camp", 2003-01-05; "When you kill one of the neophytes, Martley will spawn", 2003; "Martley appeared at the corpse", 2004-06-12). Upstream had a passive Martley standing 2.7k north of the camp; deploy/hearthdaoc-quests.json makes him an event spawn at the camp, and this copy is archived.

camps.name: Mulgrut Maggot's first decayed zombie
camps.why: Level 5 "Cleric Mulgrut": "He walks with two decayed zombies and a putrid zombie between the cemetery and the hill with the tall stone" (the quest's own text, DataQuest 20207); his company is "high-aggro and will follow mulgrut around" (Allakhazam cmob 1273, 2001-10-30), and "His buddies spawn at the same time he does" (2002-03-11); "Mulgrut's zombie groupies will take you out if you are alone" (2002-02-26). Made like the cemetery's decayed zombie 6ba397c1 with template 12334's values (level 3, size 45-55, speed 175, its articles); NPCTemplateID -1, since that template is shared and would put back its aggro 0/0 (ReplaceMobValues). It follows him as upstream's fellows follow Fjall (QuestFellowBrain; deploy/hearthdaoc-quests.json Fellows) and attacks on sight as he does (deploy/bin/mob_fixes.json). Our choice: it spawns 110 from his spawn, clear of the cemetery's other monsters, and respawns as often as he does (300 s).

camps.name: Mulgrut Maggot's putrid zombie
camps.why: Mulgrut Maggot's escort (see mulgrut-escort-1), with template 12380's values (putrid zombie: level 4, size 40-50, speed 180, slash, no articles; the same model 110).

camps.name: Mulgrut Maggot's walk
camps.why: Level 5 "Cleric Mulgrut": "he spawns in the graveyard with a zombie/lrge skelly escort and wanders oup to the top of the hill and back" (2002-03-12); "He commonly spawns inside the graveyard and them wanders about the walls outside" (Allakhazam cmob 1273, 2001-10-30); the quest's text: "between the cemetery and the hill with the tall stone". The stone is the menhir at loc 25344, 36352 on the hill north-east of the cemetery, ringed by large skeletons ("stone located on a hill w/ 2 large skeletons", WarCry 53; "the big stone ringed by large skeletons at the top of hte nearby hill", 2002-02-26), between Prydwen Keep and Cotswold (2001-11); WarCry's 2003 map marks him on this line. Our choice of points: his spawn and four more around the cemetery, each 400 or more from the last, 20-40 s at each, so he moves about it before and after each walk; then the way over the wooded hill and the valley, each point a monster's spawn spot (its ground height), at a walk; and 2 minutes by the stone. Where he waits, he stands 100-150 from other monsters' spawn spots, at the nearest one's height. Path type 2: out and back.
